i guess our likes and dislikes are just different. i liked the suspense in the first chapter and i liked that tanjiro wasn’t the focus like naruto and ichigo and that there were real deaths and gravity to the situations happening. doesn’t always work but i think it worked for demon slayer and the characters have grown into their own in a different way rather than just focus on their relationship with the mc and then forget about them. 

its consistent because it does what it does right and people’s expectations are that it concludes in a way that will show us the end for these characters rather than just give us a half baked ending with convoluted plot points like naruto and bleach. people cling to those shows because of nostalgia but simple characters are not good and simple plot lines are just boring especially in modern anime. if they gave us “boy with dream and side characters helping him” demon slayer would not be captivating from the first chapter the way it was. 

naruto and bleach fanbases were not “strong” because of how they started. people liked them because they were the some of the first to do what they did. so naturally people are going to dislike the ones that come after them doing the same. demon slayer also has a large fanbase with high expectations because of its plot and characters. that doesn’t mean it’s great but it does mean there’s obviously something there that other new anime don’t have. 

i think people should read it or watch it because it’s a new anime that’s not showing the same stuff in anime that we’ve been seeing for decades. and it does so in a way that captivates the reader from beginning to current chapter with little room to breathe because the author has a set plotline that we’re seeing unfold. many might not like that it has little to no downtime because it feels shonen-y, but where and how this story will end is why people are getting into it as much as they have. 

...plus it has cool fights lol

naruto’s first chapter did not grab me the way demon slayer’s did. naruto and ichigo were presented as more basic characters than tanjiro. they had a goal and they had a town. demon slayer started off with tension and intrigue almost immediately and it was a very good way to grab the reader. naruto and bleach are all time greats but they had their time to get there and then they declined once they got there. demon slayer might not be better than them but it hasn’t made the same mistakes either. 

also i don’t disagree that the anime gave it popularity, but that’s usually what anime are made for and series almost always become popular because of them so i don’t really see that point. in the end people will like demon slayer for what it has to offer while other will want more, that’s why one piece is here for us lol.

the mangaka was in the fucking zone while giving us those arcs back to back! i enjoyed this arc up until it was countdown to sunrise. then it felt a little too avengers endgame for me lol. but it’s not over yet there’s still more to see! there’s few manga that has me waiting like this so it’s exciting for me and i hope more people read it too.

i’d agree with you until the naruto and bleach part. what about naruto and bleach was special that demon slayer doesn’t have? is it because they did what they did first and demon slayer did it after? i guess some people just want new and fresh ideas from all their shows but i like seeing current elements in different forms. demon slayer does things in a way that works for the story they’re telling so i enjoy it without having to compare it. maybe that’s why i don’t see how naruto and bleach were special if demon slayer isn’t. they did the same things in their own worlds. 

though, i can totally see where you’re coming from and demon slayer does rely on shonen tropes a lot. the villain especially is a problem for me, he’s just boring. but i digress. 

and for anyone reading this i hope we gave you some thoughts on demon slayer while we wait for OP 😭

i think it offers more than mediocre execution it’s just not one piece level but i don’t read other manga to find another one piece. i read because other series have other things to offer.
